acceptance: Red first: TestAcquire_LiveHolderPastTTLWithHeartbeatIsNotBroken - a holder with a running heartbeat and a fake clock 40 minutes past acquire is not broken by a sibling; red on main because the sibling breaks at 15:00

Red first: TestShipWindow_TwoLanesWithSectionsLongerThanTTLNeverOverlap through enterShipWindow and holdShipWindow with a 20 minute fake section; the second lane lands only after the first releases; assert no second landing begins inside the first section
A holder whose process dies or whose context is cancelled stops beating and is broken at the TTL (TestShipWindowLease_HolderDeathRecovered stays green)
A holder that is broken by the hard cap aborts with a transient ship error and does not push (test with an injected pusher that fails the test on call)
ORCHESTRATOR_SHIP_WINDOW_LEASE_BROKEN and SHIP_WINDOW_LEASE_BROKEN appear in .evolve/signals.ndjson (test through the signal center)
Wave report counts re-audits caused by a moved main (satisfies the acceptance of ship-race-starves-a-slow-cycle)
fix: In go/internal/shipwindow add a heartbeat: while a Lease is held and its context is live, rewrite heartbeat_at every TTL/3 under the token check; Release stops it; a beat that finds a foreign token marks the lease broken and the holder aborts its section with a transient code (no unleased landing). Keep the TTL for dead or hung holders and add a hard cap on total hold time (60 min) that breaks and signals. Wire the beat in enterShipWindow (phases/ship) and holdShipWindow (core). Emit LEASE_BROKEN to the wave signal bus as well as the run bus, and emit a signal to the broken holder run. Update docs/architecture/packages/internal-shipwindow.md (D2 and 'No heartbeat refresh') and add an ADR note for the changed decision. Follow-up item: chain the identity carry across a second main move (pendingAuditedChange must use the latest carry record base, not the ledger audited base).
routed_reason: console built it (PR #1617, CI fix pending); root cause of the wave-184 ship-race thrash
summary: In wave 184 (2026-11-20 20:40Z to 02:30Z) lane cycles 2563, 2575, 2578 and 2580 aborted at ship about 10 times after audit PASS, and 4 of them re-ran a deep-tier audit (2563 twice, 2575, 2578). Five landings in 5.5 hours. Cause: shipwindow.Acquire writes heartbeat_at once, and tryAcquire breaks any live holder older than DefaultTTL (15 min). A held ship or recovery (rebase, repo-contract scan of 177 packages, composed gates, push) takes 14 to 38 minutes. Three breaks are recorded, each exactly 15:00 after the holder's heartbeat (2574 at 21:33:09 broke pid 28711; 2563 at 22:24:09 and 2575 at 23:24:54 broke pid 28710, cycle 2578). Cycle 2578 kept running unleased and landed bca876212 at 23:57:48, 40 s after cycle 2575 re-entered ship holding the same lease, so 2575 failed with GIT_FLEET_REBASE_NEEDED, then AUDIT_BINDING_HEAD_MOVED. docs/architecture/packages/internal-shipwindow.md says a held section lasts seconds to minutes; that premise is false. The same race starved cycle 2211 in wave 160 (item ship-race-starves-a-slow-cycle). The two LEASE_BROKEN signals reach only runs/cycle-N/signals.ndjson, not the wave signal bus, so no watch saw the breaks.
title: The ship-window lease is broken at 15 minutes by the next waiter, so two lanes run the same landing section and the loser loops
